issue.subject: [tools][infra] qem-bot increment-approver wrongly references both SLES+SL-Micro tests as base for approval for product specific request size:M
issue.description:
## Observation

In https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/-/jobs/6027759#L3042 qem-bot says:

```
2026-01-28 12:35:10 INFO     Found product increment request on SUSE:SLFO:Products:SL-Micro:6.2:ToTest: 399766
…
2026-01-28 12:36:11 INFO     Found product increment request on SUSE:SLFO:Products:SLES:16.0:TEST: 399799
…
2026-01-28 12:37:29 INFO     Not approving OBS request ID '399766' for the following reasons:
    The following openQA jobs ended up with result 'failed':
 - https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20724745
    The following openQA jobs ended up with result 'failed':
 - https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20753853
End of reasons for not approving OBS request ID '399766'
2026-01-28 12:37:29 INFO     Not approving OBS request ID '399799' for the following reasons:
    The following openQA jobs ended up with result 'failed':
 - https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20724745
    The following openQA jobs ended up with result 'failed':
 - https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20753853
End of reasons for not approving OBS request ID '399799'
```

qem-bot should not look at the same jobs for both different requests.

https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20724745 is sle-micro-6.2-Default-qcow-Updates-x86_64-Build61.24-vendor_affirmation_validation_security@uefi-virtio-vga so should only be relevant for the first request https://build.suse.de/request/show/399766 which is for SUSE:SLFO:Products:SL-Micro:6.2:ToTest. https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20753853 is sle-16.0-Minimal-VM-Cloud-Updates-Increments-aarch64-Build180.15-minimalvm-cloud-init@aarch64 so should only be relevant for the *second* request https://build.suse.de/request/show/399799 which is for SUSE:SLFO:Products:SLES:16.0:TEST

## Acceptance criteria
* **AC1:** qem-bot approves product increment OBS requests based on only the product relevant openQA test failures

## Suggestions
* Start with https://github.com/openSUSE/qem-bot/blob/master/openqabot/incrementapprover.py and check which openQA jobs are looked up for each request
* *DONE* Improve log messages to not have the same message twice for different requests and such

journals.notes: https://github.com/openSUSE/qem-bot/commit/ef37c1c48c738c5f83626907517812ef848676b9 made the log messages specific and some related commit (I am sure) fixed the job references. I have seen multiple successfully approved product increments for SLES as well as -SL-Micro, we are good

	The following openQA jobs ended up with result 'failed':
 - https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20753853
End of reasons for not approving OBS request ID '399799'
```

qem-bot should not look at the same jobs for both different requests.

https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20724745 is sle-micro-6.2-Default-qcow-Updates-x86_64-Build61.24-vendor_affirmation_validation_security@uefi-virtio-vga so should only be relevant for the first request 399766 which is for SUSE:SLFO:Products:SL-Micro:6.2:ToTest. https://openqa.suse.de/tests/20753853 is sle-16.0-Minimal-VM-Cloud-Updates-Increments-aarch64-Build180.15-minimalvm-cloud-init@aarch64 so should only be relevant for the *second* request 399799 which is for SUSE:SLFO:Products:SLES:16.0:TEST

```

The message "Not approving …" shows twice because incrementapprover.py says:

```
        for request in self.requests_to_approve.values():
            error_count += self._handle_approval(request)
```

at the time of writing there are two requests, one for SLES and one for SL-Micro. All should be treated separately but as the above shows – at least in the output – the same openQA jobs (which are actually all SL-Micro jobs) block both requests. So in this example SL-Micro related test failures block SLES.


## Acceptance criteria
* **AC1:** qem-bot approves product increment OBS requests based on only the product relevant openQA test failures

## Suggestions
* Start with https://github.com/openSUSE/qem-bot/blob/master/openqabot/incrementapprover.py#L412 and check which openQA jobs are looked up for each request
* Improve log messages to not have the same message twice for different requests and such
